name: Fuzzy colloquial product name
description: Tests price lookup with a very fuzzy, colloquial product reference. The customer says 'the white stuff, 16mil' instead of using the proper product name. The AI should infer they mean 16mm white melamine and return the real price.

messages.text: how much for the white stuff, 16mil

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a price with R prefix
Reply should identify the product as melamine

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Tests fuzzy matching capability. '16mil' should be interpreted as 16mm and 'the white stuff' should be matched to white melamine. The AI should confirm the product it looked up so the customer knows they were understood correctly.
